relationships.subject: Olorinab
relationships.evidence_quote: Olorinab (APD371) is an oral, peripherally acting visceral analgesic and highly selective full agonist of CB2.

relationships.subject: Olorinab
relationships.evidence_quote: Olorinab treatment significantly reduced VMRs to control levels in colitis and CVH animals.

relationships.subject: Olorinab
relationships.evidence_quote: olorinab (0.01 μM-10 μM) significantly and dose dependently decreased the activity of colonic nociceptors from colitis mice

relationships.subject: SR144528
relationships.evidence_quote: SR144528 blocked olorinab-induced inhibition of colonic nociceptors from colitis mice

key_findings: Olorinab, a selective CB2 agonist, reduces colitis and chronic visceral hypersensitivity in a CB2-dependent manner without affecting healthy controls
CB2 mRNA is found in colonic epithelium and DRG neuron subsets and is not upregulated in colitis or CVH
